subject.title: fix(memory): respect QMD timeout for memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw treat `memory.qmd.limits.timeoutMs` as the command-phase budget for interactive QMD-backed `memory_search`, accepting longer QMD turns while preserving the default 15s guards around all other work?
rationale: The code path is technically coherent and well-proven, but the behavior intentionally changes how an existing QMD timeout setting affects interactive agent wait time and overlaps with broader timeout-configuration PRs.

options.title: Land Scoped QMD Command Timeout
options.body: Rebase this PR, preserve current main’s QMD sync-on-miss guard, and keep the longer wait limited to QMD command execution.

options.title: Require Separate Opt-In
options.body: Ask for a new explicit interactive tool-timeout setting if maintainers do not want existing QMD timeout values to lengthen agent turns.

options.title: Defer To Broader Timeout Direction
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want one general `memory_search` timeout product decision instead of a QMD-owned interpretation.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped QMD Command Timeout
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR, preserve current main’s QMD sync-on-miss guard, and keep the longer wait limited to QMD command execution.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current repair commit, are assigned on the live PR, and have the clearest recent history on this memory-search timeout path.
